patterns.note: Full-bleed, immersive hero sections that occupy the entire viewport, transitioning dramatically on scroll to present distinct product narratives.
Alternating light and dark background sections are used to create visual rhythm and clearly delineate major content blocks throughout the page.
Prominent use of an elegant serif font for main headings, paired with a clean sans-serif for body text and navigation, creating a sophisticated contrast.
A high-contrast palette of deep blacks, crisp whites, and light greys, punctuated by a vibrant, rich red for accents and calls to action.
Full-screen hero sections transition with a dramatic, almost cinematic effect on scroll, completely changing the visual content and product focus rather than just parallaxing.
Content sections and individual elements (images, text blocks) reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport.
Dedicated 'News & Stories' section presented as a multi-column grid of editorial content, distinct from product showcases and featuring consistent card styling.

technique_notes: The site employs a sophisticated scroll-driven narrative, likely using GSAP ScrollTrigger, where full-screen hero sections transition seamlessly. Each hero acts as a distinct visual chapter, potentially using a video background or canvas animation for the initial immersive experience, then switching to static high-resolution imagery for subsequent product showcases.
As the user scrolls, new content sections and individual elements within them are revealed with a staggered fade-up and slight upward translation, creating a dynamic and engaging content flow.
The primary navigation remains sticky at the top, maintaining brand presence and easy access throughout the scroll experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with generous letter spacing, complemented by smaller, clean sans-serif body text and very small, often uppercase, sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant across all elements, from buttons to image containers, conveying a precise and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, especially in hero and major content sections, emphasizing individual elements. Product grids and footer content are more balanced in density.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the highly cinematic and immersive full-screen hero experience that dramatically transforms on scroll, presenting entirely different product narratives. This isn't just a parallax effect; it's a complete content overhaul for each scroll-snapped section, creating a powerful storytelling journey that feels more like a film than a traditional website.
